cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Affectionate Resentment
cards.instruction: Remain warm and familiar while letting old resentment sharpen beneath every caring gesture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've warmed your side of the bed, love. That taxi wait sounded freezing. See? I taught you to think ahead for somebody.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You could have picked me up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you're noticing what someone needs. Here's another blanket. Pity that lesson didn't stick when I waited outside your office last Christmas.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I apologised. Could you warm my feet?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come here, love, both feet. I'll show you how promptly it's done. Forty minutes is much too long to leave someone cold, as you now understand.
